关于阳台的故事(A Story about the balcony): 一篇关于家庭生活的A2短文:妮娜与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。
Last Thursday, Nina and Grace went to the balcony. Grace's birthday is in June. It takes twenty minutes to get to the balcony by bike. Woven placemats brighten the table.
The weather was snowy that day. Nina hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Grace is interested in cooking. The baby drops the pacifier and laughs.
There are always many people at the family dinner. Both of them like noodles and tea. Nina wants to be a nurse in the future. The baby takes a nap after lunch every day.
The balcony is one of the best places in the city. Nina spent the weekend at the bookstore. Nina and Grace had great fun there.
